title: Who Pays for Byzantine Robustness? Validity, Data-Share Dictatorships, and Fairness When Only a Few Hospitals Collaborate
abstract: arXiv:2611.22904v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical federated learning (FL) collaborations typically connect only three to six hospitals, yet Byzantine-robust aggregation rules are designed and benchmarked on synthetic partitions across dozens of equal-sized clients. We conduct an empirical audit of eight standard aggregation rules: FedAvg, coordinate-wise median, trimmed mean, Krum, Multi-Krum, Bulyan, geometric median (GeoMed), and Centered Clipping (CC). We evaluate both unweighted and sample-size-weighted variants across three cross-silo medical datasets from the FLamby benchmark: Fed-Heart-Disease ($n = 4$ hospitals), Fed-TCGA-BRCA ($n = 6$ regions), and Fed-ISIC2019 ($n = 6$ centres). We execute 54,214 training runs across enumerated attacker coalitions ($f \in \{1, 2\}$) paired with exact-twin leave-out controls that decompose performance drops into honest data loss versus adversarial attack damage. translated_title: 谁为拜占庭鲁棒性买单？当只有少数医院协作时的有效性、数据份额独裁与公平性问题
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.22904v1 公告类型： new 摘要：临床联邦学习（FL）协作通常只连接三到六家医院，然而拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则的设计和基准测试却是在数十个等规模客户端的合成数据划分上进行的。我们对八种标准聚合规则进行了实证审计：FedAvg、坐标中位数、截尾均值、Krum、Multi-Krum、Bulyan、几何中位数和中心裁剪。我们在来自FLamby基准的三个跨机构医疗数据集上评估了未加权和样本量加权两种变体：Fed-Heart-Disease（n=4家医院）、Fed-TCGA-BRCA（n=6个地区）和Fed-ISIC2019（n=6个中心）。我们在枚举的攻击者联盟（f ∈ {1, 2}）配置下共执行了54,214次训练运行，并采用精确孪生留出对照，将性能下降分解为诚实数据损失与对抗攻击损害两部分。我们报告了三个发现：第一，客户端数量有效性检查无法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过对八种拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则在仅有3-6家医院的真实临床联邦学习数据集上进行54,214次训练运行的实证审计，揭示了现有基于大规模合成客户端的基准测试无法反映小规模医疗协作场景下的有效性、数据份额独裁与公平性代价。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically audits eight Byzantine-robust aggregation rules across 54,214 training runs on real clinical federated learning datasets with only 3-6 hospitals, revealing that benchmarks based on large-scale synthetic partitions fail to capture validity, data-share dictatorship, and fairness costs in small cross-silo medical collaborations.
